rows.semantic_object: Role Sigil + route from Project Core
rows.screen: Home / Owner Workspace; Living Project Workspace; Studio Project; Owner Decision Mode
rows.full_motion: Project Core remains fixed; semantic route grows to only the participating Sigil; target Sigil resolves into active state; unrelated roles remain still.
rows.reduced_motion: Source focus -> crossfade/state emphasis -> destination Sigil focus; no route travel.
rows.evidence_step: role-activated: capture source frame, route-growth run, active-Sigil settle; assert unrelated-role pixels remain stable outside bounded tolerance.

rows.full_motion: Bounded role-state transition only when the role state changes; stop immediately on idle/unknown.
rows.reduced_motion: Immediate state/icon/text update with short crossfade only.
rows.evidence_step: role-state-changed: record ACTIVE->IDLE and ACTIVE->UNKNOWN; assert motion stops on UNKNOWN.

rows.screen: Living Project Workspace; Studio Project; Pulse / Visual Project Story
rows.full_motion: Source highlight -> artifact detaches -> follows semantic route -> destination highlights while artifact arrives; source and destination identities remain visible.
rows.reduced_motion: Source focus -> artifact state crossfade -> destination focus; no travel.
rows.evidence_step: handoff-started: timestamp source highlight, detach, route, destination focus; verify object identity persists.

rows.full_motion: Destination resolves accepted/verified state only after accepted event; route fades after settlement.
rows.reduced_motion: Destination accepted badge/state appears with short crossfade.
rows.evidence_step: handoff-accepted: prove accepted state appears only after accepted event timestamp.

rows.screen: Living Project Workspace; Studio Project; Pulse / Visual Project Story
rows.full_motion: Destination de-emphasizes -> artifact follows reverse semantic route -> source highlights -> Return Ticket becomes inspectable.
rows.reduced_motion: Destination focus -> crossfade returned artifact/source focus -> Return Ticket visible.
rows.evidence_step: artifact-returned: prove reverse direction, source settlement, and visible Return Ticket with no accepted-state residue.

rows.semantic_object: Originating project context + Decision Card + evidence/dissent paths
rows.full_motion: Project context de-emphasizes without disappearing; Decision Card elevates; evidence/dissent paths become readable; motion settles into inspectable state.
rows.reduced_motion: Project context de-emphasis crossfade -> Decision Card focus -> evidence/dissent indicators visible.
rows.evidence_step: decision-required: verify hierarchy shift and retained project context from pre-event to settled frame.

rows.full_motion: Decision Card resolves into recorded state/history; no downstream running animation until a separate project/autopilot event arrives.
rows.evidence_step: decision-recorded: prove recorded state and prove autopilot remains unchanged absent a resume event.

rows.screen: Software Autopilot Project; Checkpoint / Recovery / Fork
rows.full_motion: Forward flow stops -> current work de-emphasizes -> last VERIFIED checkpoint focuses -> bounded rewind toward that checkpoint -> pending recovery hold.
rows.reduced_motion: Forward activity stops -> last VERIFIED checkpoint focus -> pending recovery label/state; no rewind travel.
rows.evidence_step: recovery-started: assert running motion stops before rewind and pending state remains after rewind.

rows.full_motion: Intent cue only; selected checkpoint focuses and restore remains pending. Never animate success.
rows.evidence_step: restore-requested: assert no RESTORED/VERIFIED visual before verified event.

rows.semantic_object: Verified restored checkpoint + project current state
rows.screen: Checkpoint / Recovery / Fork; Living Project Workspace
rows.full_motion: Pending hold resolves -> verified restored checkpoint settles -> project state reconciles -> only then may normal flow resume on a later running event.
rows.reduced_motion: Verified restored state crossfade; no travel.
rows.evidence_step: restore-verified: assert VERIFIED settle occurs after event and no fake running state is introduced.

rows.semantic_object: Parent checkpoint + preserved original + Branch A/B
rows.full_motion: Source checkpoint pauses -> branch grows from parent -> A/B identities emerge -> original remains visibly preserved -> equal compare state settles.
rows.reduced_motion: Parent focus -> A/B cards appear together -> original-preserved indicator remains.
rows.evidence_step: fork-created: verify branch origin, simultaneous A/B availability, and preserved original.

rows.full_motion: Explicit selection emphasis resolves on chosen branch; unselected branch remains inspectable; original remains preserved.
rows.reduced_motion: Selected state/icon emphasis with no travel.
rows.evidence_step: branch-selected: prove only chosen branch gains selected state and comparison remains available.

rows.semantic_object: Verified stage rail + final artifacts + Work Receipt
rows.full_motion: Verified stages settle -> final artifacts gather into receipt context -> active motion stops -> Work Receipt appears -> one restrained completion cue -> next actions become inspectable.
rows.reduced_motion: Verified states settle -> artifacts/receipt crossfade into final arrangement -> final status shown; no gather travel.
rows.evidence_step: project-completed-verified: prove event gating, artifact gather/settle, stopped activity, receipt appearance, and single restrained cue.
